run_read_binarized_with_dict: run the script to decode a binarized dataset file using a dictionary and print text to stdout
run_read_binarized_raw_tokens: run the script to read a binarized file without a dictionary and print raw token IDs to stdout
run_read_binarized_lazy_impl: run the script with the lazy dataset implementation to read a binarized file and output text
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that configures argparse with --dataset-impl, --dict, and --input arguments
review_main: review the main function that loads a binarized dataset and prints each line as text or token IDs
